title: Opening and Ending · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Opening and Ending · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write a simple opening sentence and an unrelated ending sentence on separate slips. The lead tells a short story that begins and ends with those sentences. Both sentences appear in the right places and the story connects them. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Opening and Ending, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Both sentences appear in the right places and the story connects them.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: Both sentences appear in the right places and the story connects them.
